no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: AEON pivoted ABP-450 from Phase 2/3 therapeutic clinical development to a biosimilar-to-BOTOX regulatory pathway. As of 2025-2026, the program is in analytical comparability and FDA Biosimilar Biological Product Development (BPD Type 2a/2b) discussions, not active interventional Phase 1/2/3 trials. All four prior ctgov Phase 2 studies (cervical dystonia, migraine prevention, and their extensions) are listed as COMPLETED or TERMINATED. No new active P1/P2/P3 study has been initiated.
